biography_summary: 宝拉·拉维里(Paula Rawiri)是新西兰资深公共服务官员，现任新西兰毛利发展部(Te Puni Kōkiri)政策副秘书长(Deputy Secretary – Policy)，为该部行政领导团队核心成员。拉维里为毛利裔，隶属Ngāti Tūwharetoa和Ngāti Ruanui部落，其中Ngāi Te Rangiita和Ngāti Tūtemōhuta为其亚族(hapū)，陶波(Taupō)为其祖籍地(tūrangawaewae)。她在陶波长大，后居纳鲁阿瓦希亚(Ngāruawāhia)，现驻Te Puni Kōkiri汉密尔顿办公室。拉维里毕业于怀卡托大学(University of Waikato)，获教育学学士(Bachelor of Education)和毛利与太平洋发展研究生文凭(Post Graduate Diploma in Māori and Pacific Development)。她在新西兰教育部(Ministry of Education)服务长达18年，自2002年起担任多个领导职务，最近出任怀卡托区教育局长(Director of Education, Waikato)，专精于毛利教育政策制定与实施。约2020年前后加入Te Puni Kōkiri，先后担任区域合作与运营副秘书长和政策副秘书长，负责监督对毛利社区创新能力的投资，推动毛利家庭、氏族和部落实现自决与代际转型目标。拉维里持有公司董事资格认证(CMinsD)，在毛利教育发展和公共政策领域拥有深厚的运营管理与战略规划经验。

collection_meta.notes: Profile built from Te Puni Kōkiri official executive team page, BusinessDesk, LinkedIn (limited access), Facebook pepeha post, Datanyze and ZoomInfo. Paula Rawiri is a senior public servant, not an elected politician. Career: 18 years at Ministry of Education (2002-2020, rising to Director of Education Waikato), then moved to Te Puni Kōkiri as Deputy Secretary – Regional Partnerships and Operations, later promoted to Deputy Secretary – Policy. Education: University of Waikato (BEd, PGDip Māori & Pacific Development). Iwi: Ngāti Tūwharetoa, Ngāti Ruanui. Hapū: Ngāi Te Rangiita, Ngāti Tūtemōhuta. Holds CMinsD (Chartered Member of the Institute of Directors). Based in Hamilton office. Note: person_list titles '政策事务副秘书长' and '赛马部长' appear to conflate roles; she is a public service Deputy Secretary, not a political minister for Racing.
